description: Find saved images, videos and other content in the connected account’s library. Search by title or exact asset ID. Returns up to 25 newest matching assets; an empty result means no owned asset matched. Pass kind=brand_asset to list Brand Kit rows, or any other exact row kind (image, video, …). Page the listing with offset: keep calling with offset += limit while morePagesMayExist is true; a full page may have more rows behind it, a short page is the end. Each owned row includes its exact updated_at version for photo selection; this timestamp is not reviewed private evidence or permission to generate from the public URL.
name: soclo_library_search
title: Find your saved Soclo content
